tonight.headline: Before kickoff: everyone you start is active or cleared — the London game locks first
body: Bad news first: Alvin Kamara is still questionable after three limited practices and sits behind Kendre Miller; Justin Jefferson and Ollie Gordon are on bye. Rico Dowdle is expected back in Pittsburgh, so Jaylen Warren loses some of the 100% backfield share he had for three weeks — ESPN already has that in his 15.0.

Nothing to do. Tuten and Fairbairn are active in London (07:30), every 11:00 starter is off the final reports, and the flex is a 12.4-to-12.4 coin flip that is already in the safe order: Allgeier plays at 14:05, McLaurin on Monday night. 127.1 projected against 112.5; ESPN 57%. Inactives for the 11:00 games come at 09:30 — check once; nothing in the reporting says you will need to act.

case.label: Why leave it
case.body: A projection tie carries no thesis. Allgeier is Arizona's lead back with Jeremiyah Love ruled out (TSN 16 Oct: no IR, re-evaluated daily); McLaurin is cleared but practised only twice, limited (SI final report 17 Oct). Either is the projection lineup.

case.label: Provisional
case.body: This brief was written at 07:00, before the 09:30 and 12:35 inactive lists. Every lineup line here assumes the Friday and Saturday reports hold.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Allgeier inactive at 12:35: McLaurin into the flex. Any 11:00 starter inactive at 09:30: McLaurin into that slot. Otherwise nothing.

case.body: He goes unclaimed and scores under 8 a game over Weeks 7-9 — then passing was right. Or a rival claims him and he outscores Coker in two of those weeks.
